name: Monad

key_findings: No gate cap binds on either axis.

Tokenomics & Supply (34) is MON's weakest category by a wide margin -- team, investors, and treasury hold roughly 50.6% of supply behind a single 12-month cliff, with a November 24, 2026 unlock of about 1.4x current circulating supply landing in one day.
On-Chain Health (54) reflects a 150-170x transactions-per-active-address ratio independently flagged as a farming signature.

Privacy & Confidentiality (42) credits Unlink, live on Monad mainnet since June 2026 and in scope because it deploys as a smart contract with no separate chain and no bridge custody. Discounted heavily for age and absent adoption data.
A full-EVM chain clearing Deterministic Finality outright -- 300ms blocks and 600ms full finality post-MIP-12.
Execution Layer (86) is MON's strongest AI category -- fast block times and native Execution Events streaming.
Scored on its actual record rather than penalized for a maturity window it has not had time to accumulate.

watch_items: November 24, 2026 unlock cliff (16.6-16.8B MON, roughly 1.4x current float, single day) -- re-assess Tokenomics & Supply and On-Chain Health after the unlock.
Incentive wind-down -- expected 30-70%+ TVL contraction once points programs lapse; re-assess On-Chain Health when this occurs.
Automated slashing is currently logging-only -- the single largest deduction inside AI Security Posture; re-check at every future re-assessment.
Unlink adoption data would be a re-credit candidate for Privacy & Confidentiality, which is currently discounted for absent usage evidence.
